summary: Implemented executor window-function support with a new planner Window step and efficient Python evaluation for ranking, aggregate, frame, exclusion, and navigation functions. Added QUALIFY handling, named windows, window composition with grouped queries/order/distinct, and safeguards for window-bearing subqueries during optimization. Added frame-efficient prefix/sparse-table evaluation and verified 50k-row running/range/navigation smoke performance (<1s each locally), plus CTE/subquery/grouped/window regression smoke tests.
